20048.long_desc:
The Sanwa Joystick (JLF-TP-8YT) is a Japan-made premium joystick that used in most Japan arcade machines made by Taito, Sega and Namco. Because of the high precision and reliability, it is regarded as one of the best joysticks among video game players. This joystick work with a wide range of Sanwa ball tops and bat tops, as well as a variety of other tops (bubbletops, etc). The Sanwa JLF-TP-8YT comes as a fully assembled joystick including a color ball top, dust cover and mounting plate. Colour options include;

- JLF-TP-8YT-K Black
- JLF-TP-8YT-W White
- JLF-TP-8YT-DH Grey
- JLF-TP-8YT-R Red
- JLF-TP-8YT-Y Yellow
- JLF-TP-8YT-B Blue
- JLF-TP-8YT-VI Violet
- JLF-TP-8YT-O Orange
- JLF-TP-8YT-P Pink
- JLF-TP-8YT-DB Dark Blue
- JLF-TP-8YT-MB Matt Blue
- JLF-TP-8YT-G Green

The Sanwa JLF-TP-8YT is our preferred choice in Arcooda arcade machines.
20048.meta_description: The Sanwa Joystick (JLF-TP-8YT)  is the premium joystick used in most Japan arcades and has been widely adopted in the Madcatz series of joysticks. These joysticks work with a wide range of Sanwa ball tops and bat tops, as well as a variety of other tops (bubbletops, etc). The Sanwa JLF-TP-8YT comes as a fully assembled joystick including a white-ball top, dust cover and mounting plate.
20048.key_features:
- High quality Japan-made joystick
- Suitable for control panels made of steel or plastic to a max. of 5mm thick
- Switchable Ball Top - variety of colors are available
- Can be changed to 4 ways or 8 ways operation
- Ideal to replace arcade / home console joystick for fighting style games and any joystick heavy games
